PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>

question: What share of patients billed for type 2 diabetes were older than 65 at the time of the diagnosis?
reference:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX geno: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?patients)
       (SUM(?over_65) AS ?patients_over_65)
       (ROUND(1000.0 * SUM(?over_65) / COUNT(*)) / 10 AS ?pct)
WHERE {
  SELECT ?g (MAX(IF(?age_years > 65, 1, 0)) AS ?over_65) WHERE {
    GRAPH ?g {
      ?code a icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") .
      ?dx sphn:hasCode ?code ; a sphn:BilledDiagnosis ; sphn:hasSubjectAge ?age .
      ?age sphn:hasQuantity ?q .
      ?q sphn:hasValue ?age_years ; sphn:hasUnit/sphn:hasCode ?u .
      ?u a ucum:a .
    }
  } GROUP BY ?g
}

PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX geno: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?b) AS ?preterm_births) WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?b a sphn:Birth ; sphn:hasGestationalAge ?ga .
    ?ga sphn:hasQuantity ?q .
    ?q sphn:hasValue ?ga_days ; sphn:hasUnit/sphn:hasCode ?u .
    ?u a ucum:d .
  }
  FILTER (?ga_days < 259)
}

question: How many adverse events had a fatal outcome?
reference:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX geno: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?e) AS ?fatal_events) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g { ?e a sphn:AdverseEvent ; sphn:hasOutcome sphn-individual:Fatal . }
}

question: How are adverse events distributed by their consequences?
reference:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX geno: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT ?consequence (COUNT(DISTINCT ?e) AS ?events) WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g { ?e a sphn:AdverseEvent ; sphn:hasConsequences ?consequence . }
} GROUP BY ?consequence ORDER BY DESC(?events)

question: How many patients carry at least one homozygous genetic variant?
reference:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>

PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX geno: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g { ?d a sphn:VariantDescriptor ; sphn:hasZygosityCode ?z . ?z a geno:0000136 . }
}
